description:
Open a refund.

Starts a refund in the asset that was paid. We email the buyer a link to give an address; the link is never returned, since whoever holds it decides where the money goes. With no email on the invoice, the owner makes one in the dashboard. When the address is checked, the refund is `ready_to_send` with `amount_to_send`. Refused with `sanctioned_sender` when money on the invoice came from an address on a sanctions list, or one the coin's issuer froze: sending it back may itself be prohibited, so nothing refunds it — leave it and talk to a lawyer.

Test keys only: refused with a live key.

Cannot be undone — Opens a refund to the buyer. Ask the person first, then call with `confirm: true`.

amount.description: In the paid asset's smallest unit. Default: everything still refundable.

confirm.description: true once the person has agreed to this exact call. Without it nothing is done.

name: create_refund
title: Open a refund
